name: Seaweed salad
summary: Seaweed from the reefs around gành Đá Đĩa, soaked in fresh water and tossed with herbs, shredded coconut, chopped mango, lime, and roasted peanuts. Broken sesame rice crackers go in the bowl.
origin: Phu Yen. The reefs at gành Đá Đĩa, on Du lịch Phú Yên’s 17 June 2021 article.
howToEat: Soak the seaweed, cut it to chopstick length, and set it with herbs, coconut, mango, lime, and peanuts. Break in a sesame rice cracker and spoon on mắm chua ngọt, fish sauce pounded with green chilli, or soy sauce for a vegetarian plate.
where: The seaweed grows on the reefs and rock shelves, including gành Đá Đĩa.
seoTitle: Seaweed salad at Ganh Da Dia — coconut, mango, peanuts
seoDescription: Ganh Da Dia seaweed with coconut, mango, lime, peanuts, and sesame rice crackers.
